title: Limit assignment matrix
description: 12 behaviour grades x 8 utilisation bands x 6 months-on-book bands x 2 products = 1152 cells, 3456 values. Authored in a spreadsheet by Credit Risk Policy, quarterly. Every value on this sheet is typed by a human being.

multiplier.description: current_limit x multiplier is the uncapped target

max_increase.description: ceiling on the rand increase from this cell

min_increment.description: below this the cell yields no increase at all

validate.message: cell {keys} missing; the matrix must be complete before it is trusted
cell {cell}: grade {a} receives a larger multiplier ({ma}) than grade {b} ({mb}) at the same utilisation and tenure
validate.note: FLAGS rather than forbids (s6.3.2). The matrix is deliberately not monotonic in the obvious direction and a validator that can only reject cannot express that. Accepted warnings are recorded in the manifest with who accepted them.

diff.note: 'Policy sent a new spreadsheet' is not a reviewable change (s6.3.3).

unit_note: Money is authored in whole rand and converted to int64 cents exactly once, at load. A spreadsheet in rand and an engine in cents that disagree by a factor of 100 is a silent 100x error; declaring the unit on the schema is what makes the conversion the loader's job rather than a convention someone remembers.
